more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Chloropentafluoroethane is a fluorinated compound used as an aerating agent for specified foamed or sprayed foods. FDA describes use alone or in mixtures with certain other food gases. The regulation sets high-purity requirements and limits on fluorinated impurities. Its propellant effect is incidental to the stated aerating function.
more_info.uses: Used to aerate specified foamed or sprayed food products, alone or with the gases named in the US regulation. Food standards, high-purity requirements and the minimum necessary technological use apply.
